name: Silly Balls
teaser: Just a silly little mod that adds some silly fun
description_html:
Shooting an enemy has never been more fun! Every hit makes a bunch of bouncy colorful balls fly everywhere!
This mod is very customizable allowing you to change the sillyballs bounciness, maximum and minimum size, shrink multiplier, spawn amount, and spawn force. Take a look at the settings details below for more information. I encourage you to mess with the settings and cause chaos.

Download instructions

Download link will take you to the releases on Github.

Download SillyBalls.zip if you are playing SPT without Fika or download SillyBallsFIKA.zip if you are playing SPT with Fika.

Extract the zip and add the dll to your BepInEx/plugins folder.

Leave a comment if you encounter any problems with the mod and I will see what I can do.

Thank you!

Enable Constant Physics: Tarkov physics will stay enabled. (Probably impacts performance)

Spawn On Hit: When enabled silly balls will spawn when an enemy is hit.

**Spawn On Kill:**When enabled silly balls will spawn when an enemy is killed.

Bounciness: Determines how bouncy the silly balls should be.

Maximum Size: Determines the maximum size a silly ball can be.

Minimum Size: Determines the minimum size a silly ball can be.

Shrink Multiplier: How fast silly balls will shrink. The larger the number the faster they shrink.

Spawn Amount: The amount of silly balls that should be created on a hit and kill. (>20 freezes on spawn)

Spawn Force: The amount of force applied to a silly ball when created.
